withdrawConsent.title: Withdraw health-data consent
withdrawConsent.lead: You can withdraw consent for Soma to process substance-use, abstinence, and wellbeing data. This does not close your account.
withdrawConsent.bulletData: Substance tracking, the wellbeing journal, recovery achievements, feedback, and XP derived from those data will be deleted from the live database.
withdrawConsent.bulletAccount: Your account stays open: you can still sign in and use educational features that do not need those data.
withdrawConsent.bulletBackups: Encrypted backups may be kept for 7 days (daily) and 28 days (weekly). This withdrawal does not erase them immediately.
withdrawConsent.bulletNoReentry: You can allow saving again later. Soma does not restore data that has already been deleted.
withdrawConsent.bulletDraft: This mechanism is a development draft. It does not state a final legal basis.
withdrawConsent.dialogBody: Confirm that you understand the consequences, then enter your current password. Soma will withdraw consent only after that confirmation.
withdrawConsent.acknowledge: I understand that my recovery and wellbeing data in the live database will be deleted and that I cannot enter them again until a new consent exists.
withdrawConsent.wrongPassword: The password is incorrect. Consent was not withdrawn.
withdrawConsent.failed: Could not withdraw consent. Check your connection and try again.
withdrawConsent.success: Consent has been withdrawn. Your account remains open.
withdrawConsent.alreadyBody: Soma no longer processes substance-use, abstinence, or wellbeing data on your account. Educational features and the demo remain available. If you allow saving again, previous data are not restored.

contextualConsent.title: Save your path
contextualConsent.lead: If you want Soma to remember substances, abstinence dates, or your journal, it needs your permission. The atlas, educational missions, and the demo can be used without that.
contextualConsent.what: Soma would store the substances you choose, use or abstinence dates, wellbeing notes, and what it calculates from them, such as recovery estimates or some achievements.
contextualConsent.why: This is so you can see a personal tracking view. It is not a diagnosis or a clinical measurement.
contextualConsent.voluntary: It is voluntary. You can say not now.
contextualConsent.withdraw: You can withdraw this permission later from Account. That deletes those data from the live database.
contextualConsent.education: Educational content stays available if you do not consent.
contextualConsent.withdrawnNote: You withdrew this permission before. If you grant it again, Soma does not restore data that were already deleted.
contextualConsent.checkbox: I allow Soma to store these path data.
contextualConsent.network: Could not save the permission. Check your connection and try again.
contextualConsent.version: This permission does not match the current version. Reload the page and try again.
contextualConsent.failed: Could not save the permission. Try again.
contextualConsent.dismissed: All right. You can turn it on later from Account, or when you want to use live tracking.
contextualConsent.liveHint: To use live tracking, allow Soma to save your data.
contextualConsent.required: To save these data, first allow Soma to keep them.

delete.title: Delete my account
delete.lead: This permanently removes your Soma account. It is not an immediate action — review the consequences first.
delete.bulletData: Your profile, registered substances and dates, journal, missions, achievements, progress, feedback, and sessions are deleted.
delete.bulletBackups: Deleting the account does not necessarily mean backups and operational logs disappear immediately.
delete.bulletInvite: If you want to register again while the beta is closed, you will need a new invitation.
delete.dialogBody: Confirm that you understand the consequences, then enter your current password. Soma will only delete the account after that confirmation.
delete.acknowledge: I understand that this cannot be undone and that my personal data in Soma will be deleted.
delete.wrongPassword: The password is incorrect. Your account was not deleted.
delete.failed: Could not delete the account. Check your connection and try again.
